newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products- gas oil dips, fuel oil tone firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products- gas oil dips, fuel oil tone firm.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday morning, with gas oil weakened by softer futures, but fuel oil offers firmer, dealers said.
Heating oil barges were down by around $1 a tonne as IPE March futures dipped. Offers for prompt material were barely changed at IPE March +$1 fob ARA.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were offered about $2 higher at $86 fob ARA as buyers appeared more numerous, although the bids themselves still held at Friday's closing level of $83 fob ARA.
